about: Questions for the SQL writer, asked against the ecolink_eval database (scripts/seed_eval_db.py) — never the real one. 'Today' in that database is fixed at 15 September 2026, so time-sensitive questions name their dates instead of saying 'overdue' or 'this month', and a correct query returns the same rows next year. XiYanSQL drafts a query for every question; a person corrects each draft by checking the rows it returns, and only corrected drafts are trained on or scored against. set='score' marks the 40 questions held out for measuring models: never train on them, and for the fairest comparison correct them without leaning on the draft. Writes (kind='write') are asked with admin permission and must satisfy app/chat/guard.py: one statement, only business tables, and UPDATE/DELETE always with a WHERE. INSERTs must supply id = gen_random_uuid() — no table defaults its id — while created_at/updated_at fill themselves. A deal's value is the BUYER leg's value, never the sum of every leg; when a commission rate changes, the commission amount changes with it.
